questions.stem: Which of the following functions is a conformal mapping that maps the unit disk δ = {z : |z| < 1} onto the upper half-plane H = {z : Im(z) > 0}?
questions.solution: The correct conformal mapping is f(z) = φ(z) = e^(iθz), which maps the unit disk to the upper half-plane by stretching it along the imaginary axis. The other options do not preserve angles or local structure, making them non-conformal mappings.
